'''Reiko Kerevon''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]]. 

==Appearance==
She is stout with long, dark hair in which she wears silver bells.{{ref/book|10|19}} 

==Abilities==
With a [[One Power]] strength level of {{opsl|44}}, Reiko is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] for an Aes Sedai and therefore stands very low in their hierarchy. She is the third weakest Aes Sedai we know of, with only [[Marris Thornhill]] and [[Daigian Moseneillin]] beign weaker.

She is an expert at reading residues.{{Ref/book|10|19}}

==History==
Reiko is an [[Arafellin]]. She was born in {{ne|827}} and is 173 years old. 

==Activities==
Reiko is one of the group of sisters sent to investigate what happened at [[Shadar Logoth]] after the beacon of ''saidar'' during the [[Cleansing of saidin|Cleansing of ''saidin'']]. {{Ref/book|10|16}}

Some time after they report that they found a large hole where Shadar Logoth used to be{{Ref/book|10|19}}. Reading the residues of Power they discovered also that a huge amount of ''[[saidin]]'' was used along ''saidar''.
